title: Best way to deploy LLMs in production?
body: We are looking to deploy a Llama-3 70B model. What is the standard stack? We care about high throughput and low latency. Is vLLM still the best choice or should we look at TensorRT-LLM?
comments: vLLM is great for high throughput because of PagedAttention, but if you want the absolute lowest latency on Nvidia hardware, TensorRT-LLM is usually better, though harder to set up.
Don't forget about quantization. Using AWQ or GPTQ with vLLM gives a good balance.
If you're getting OOM (Out Of Memory) errors, try reducing the KV cache size or using quantization.

title: vLLM vs TGI for deployment
body: Has anyone compared vLLM and HuggingFace TGI? We need something that supports continuous batching and handles concurrent requests well.
comments: Both support continuous batching. vLLM has historically been faster for us, but TGI has better support for some specialized models.
We hit an OOM issue with TGI when the batch size spiked. vLLM handled the same load without crashing.
